failure_route: At the intermediate state, absence of populated content or unchanged status means first success has not occurred.

Choose the visible valid target or correct the shown selection/configuration.
Reapply or wait for system feedback, and accept completion only when the recorded populated result appears.

source_value.trigger: No control is activated anywhere in the excerpt; the only input visible is pointer travel across the Applications widget between 14.25s and 14.75s, from x381,y200 to x332,y183 (measured on the 640x360 frames).
source_value.start_state: Console Home at 0.00s with all six widgets already populated: Recently visited (12 service links), Applications showing 'No applications', Welcome to AWS, AWS Health (Open issues 0, Scheduled changes 1, Other notifications 1) and Cost and usage ($762.44 current month, $1,077.29 forecast).
source_value.end_state: The same Console Home page at 14.98s with identical widget content and identical figures; only the pointer has moved.
source_value.continuity: The layout is spatially frozen: consecutive frames sampled at 4 fps differ by 0.00/255 mean absolute grayscale for 14 of the 15 seconds, and no pixel changes by more than 30 until 14.25s, so nothing in the shell or work area is repositioned or redrawn.
source_value.feedback: No feedback appears because no control is activated; no hover highlight, focus ring, spinner, or status change is visible in any of the 60 sampled frames.
source_value.reduced_motion_equivalent: Not demonstrated: no motion-preference control is shown, and the excerpt itself is already a static rendering, so it contains no animation for a reduced-motion mode to replace.
